headline: Analysis of the 2027 Federal Expenditure Budget (Presupuesto de Egresos de la Federación)
summary: Mexico's Chamber of Deputies approved the 2027 federal expenditure budget at 10.64 trillion pesos, up 1.3% in real terms from 2026. Analysts question whether planned revenue will cover spending within the deficit target.
why: Mexico's federal budget and deficit path influence sovereign debt ratings, peso-denominated bond yields and the country's fiscal credibility with investors.
original_headline: Análisis del Presupuesto de Egresos de la Federación 2027
